title: Stripe billing webhook: verify, record receipt, forward invoice events to SQS, fork reconciliation

hops.notes: Controller has no @Transactional. Takes the Stripe-Signature header and the raw String body.
Called on the injected StripeWebhookService bean (a concrete class, not an interface), so it goes through the Spring proxy and @Transactional applies.
Private method, self-invoked. Wraps the Stripe SDK's SignatureVerificationException in InvalidSignatureException (line 65). Runs after T1 has begun, before any write.
T1 does not propagate to the pool thread. No class named CustomerReconciliationService exists in the repository, so its body and side effects are unknown.

boundaries.notes: Default attributes: REQUIRED propagation, rollback on RuntimeException and Error only. The caller has no transaction, so T1 is new. The transaction manager bean was not inspected.

Inherited JpaRepository.save; the repository declares no custom save. The entity uses @GeneratedValue IDENTITY (EventReceipt.java:17). Insert of provider_event_id, event_type, payload (jsonb) and received_at, durable only when T1 commits. handle() does not call findByProviderEventId (EventReceiptRepository.java:9) first.
Sent only when event.getType() starts with "invoice." (line 52). Runs inside T1's method scope but before T1 commits; SqsTemplate is not a JPA transactional resource. Sends the raw webhook payload.

billingExecutor is Executors.newFixedThreadPool(4) (BillingInfrastructureConfig.java:15): an in-memory queue, not Spring-managed. The returned Future is discarded. Submitted before T1 commits, so the task can start before the receipt row is committed.
T1 commits in the transactional proxy when handle() returns normally, after the SQS send and the executor submit.
Rejection path: InvalidSignatureException caught at line 32. The exception leaves handle(), so T1 ends without commit; no write has happened by then.
Acceptance path, reached after T1 has committed. Other exceptions from handle() are not caught here.

acknowledgement.description: HTTP 200 to the payment provider at BillingWebhookController line 36, after StripeWebhookService.handle has returned and T1 has committed. Before it: the receipt insert (committed), the SQS send for invoice.* events (accepted by the broker) and the reconciliation task (only queued in the in-memory billingExecutor, possibly unfinished).

stoppedAt.reason: Stripe SDK library call for signature verification; not repository code.
Known framework boundary (MESSAGE_SEND); the queue consumer is a separate flow.
No source for this type in the repository (absent from the atlas and from Grep).

openQuestions: CustomerReconciliationService is referenced (StripeWebhookService.java:27) but not defined in the repository: what does reconcileCustomer write or call, and is it transactional?
InvalidSignatureException is imported from com.acme.care.billing.service but not defined in the repository: is it unchecked? This decides whether T1 rolls back on that path.
Is there a unique constraint on billing_event_receipt.provider_event_id? No DDL or migration was inspected, and handle() does not check findByProviderEventId before inserting.
How do exceptions other than InvalidSignatureException that leave handle() (DB, SQS, executor rejection) map to an HTTP status? No @ControllerAdvice was inspected.
Configured values of care.billing.invoice-queue and care.billing.stripe.webhook-secret were not inspected.
Which PlatformTransactionManager backs @Transactional? Not inspected; a single JPA transaction manager is assumed.

Only one entry point matched 'webhook' (EP-9df71973). EP-8e45afc0 (Kafka paymentEventsContainer, BillingKafkaConfig.java:23) also receives payment events but is not an HTTP provider callback, so it was not traced.
